decisions.reason: Selecting the landing-site subdomain URL does not change the Webflow platform or Basic hosting plan.
Routing the landing site to a selected subdomain leaves the existing product root URL and its required LOTCLIP content unchanged.
The subdomain selection does not change the landing page's content mix, specification source, or screenshot selection.
The domain-routing decision has no effect on the requirement to present the landing page without animations.
Selecting a subdomain does not alter the landing site's visual style, palette source, or approved design reference.
The selected landing-site subdomain does not change the dealer-login button's placement or destination URL.
The routing change does not modify the hero asset, its mobile-phone presentation, or its supporting visual content.
Selecting the landing-site subdomain does not change the form-submission trigger or email recipients.
